news.title: Your launcher works!
news.body: This news feed, the online/offline light, the realmlist and the Play button are all driven by manifest.json. Edit this file (or host it on GitHub) to change what everyone sees.

news.title: Auto-updates are ready
news.body: Add entries to the "patches" list (use tools\Make-Manifest.ps1) and the launcher will download changed MPQs into the client's Data folder before launching.
